notes: §1985:VIII.4.4.2 prints the relative file's OPEN as one or more groups, each INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O or EXTEND followed by one or more file-names, with none of the sequential format's REVERSED and NO REWIND phrases. openStatement is OPEN openClause+, openClause an openMode with openFileSpec+, and BindOpen binds each file of each group with its group's mode from MapOpenMode, one implicit OPEN per file-name; the two tape phrases the superset openFileSpec parses are kept off a relative file by CheckOpenTapePhrase (NO REWIND is COBOL1802, REVERSED COBOL2210), and the SHARING and RETRY phrases of the later editions are refused at 85 (COBOL0900 for SHARING; RETRY is not read as a phrase below 2002 and fails as an undefined file-name). Probes at --std 85 accept all four modes in one statement and a repeated mode, and refuse OPEN with no mode, a mode with no file, a record-name and an undefined name; the witness opens two relative files under OUTPUT, I-O with INPUT, EXTEND and INPUT and reads back what each wrote.

next.reason: 1985 relative OPEN is {INPUT|OUTPUT|I-O|EXTEND} {file-name} ... repeated. §2023:14.9.27.2 keeps the four modes and repetition but adds the optional sharing-phrase and retry-phrase, which the 1985 format refuses; WITH NO REWIND remains unavailable to relative files (§2023:14.9.27.3 SR5 'The NO REWIND phrase may be specified only for sequential files'). Every 1985 form keeps its meaning; more forms are accepted. CHANGED (looser).
